known_prior.f_shape: F is state.living.fast with shape (groups=4, fast_heads=2, key_width=32, value_width=32) = 8192 elements
known_prior.write_operator: edit_fast: M' = (1-chi) M + chi * ( (I - beta * d d^T) (decay * M) + k (write * v)^T ), d = erase * k, beta = eta ||d||^2 / (1 + eta ||d||^2) in (0,1), eta = 16 sigmoid(strength); the erase step is the (I + eta e e^T)^{-1} proximal form and is non-expansive for every e and eta >= 0
known_prior.read_operator: read_fast: value_h = M_h q_h, q_h = unit_ball(fast_queries[g*heads+h]([state_normalize(h_g), event, goal, nu])); write key k comes from a DIFFERENT MLP (write_heads) over [state_normalize(h_g), event, goal, nu, past_error, missing, mode]; there is no weight tying between k and q
known_prior.second_pathway: addressed_store (20.3a) uses key = mean of BytePatchEncoder.context over the turn query bytes (128-d) and value = the then-current F; addressed_store_enabled=False for the whole 20.4c_r2 / 21.1 / 21.3 lineage and for this topic

prior_20_3a.note: the 22 query keys of the second pathway are nearly collinear; this is a reading about the encoder-mean key, not about write_heads keys

criteria.question: Under the unchanged C12 structural parent and the unchanged current graph, does the fast weight F carry a function class that can separate and address per-question / per-feedback-event values?
criteria.primary_metric: forced-write key-space separability: effective rank, pairwise cosine separability and condition number of the write keys emitted by write_heads under an allowed=all-True replay, plus the closed-form tied-key readout accuracy
criteria.forced_write_definition: the ONLY intervention is the per-group/per-head boolean write-permission mask passed as allowed=torch.ones((groups, fast_heads), dtype=bool). No parameter changes, no optimizer step, no graph edit, no checkpoint write, no data change

definitions.timing_coverage: written_turns / correction_turns, where written is the fast-write flag reported per turn; binding value is the MINIMUM over the four checkpoints
definitions.effective_rank: number of singular values s_i of the stacked key matrix K with s_i / s_max >= 1e-2
definitions.pairwise_separable_fraction: fraction of unordered pairs (i,j) with |cos(k_i, k_j)| <= key_cosine_threshold; binding value is the MINIMUM over the 8 (group, head) key stacks
definitions.key_norm_median: median L2 norm of the write keys; a near-zero key makes the outer product vanish and the readout identically zero, so it is a hard failure not a degenerate pass
definitions.condition_number: s_max / s_min over the non-degenerate singular values of K; reported for the best (group, head) stack only, as a global ill-conditioning diagnostic
definitions.query_alignment: median cosine between the read query q_i and the write key k_i produced from the same context; a small value means the two independent MLPs occupy different subspaces and no tied readout can work
definitions.capacity: sum over (group, head) of min(32, tau_decay) where tau_decay = 1 / (1 - decay) from the decay head; an upper bound on how many events one matrix can carry before exponential forgetting erases the earliest
definitions.closed_form_readout: V_hat = M_final K (G + eps I)^{-1} with G = K^T K, eps = 1e-6; leave-one-event-out nearest-neighbour decode from V_hat to the event id
definitions.effective_dof: number of distinct F vectors observed under forced write across the correction surfaces; below 3 no PASS verdict is valid

control_statistic.window_identity: one fitted probe on the 2-d feedback-window one-hot of 20.2s
control_statistic.label_permutation_5_seeds: per-seed MAX over seeds 20261105..20261109, the 20.3a frozen statistic; mean is reported for sensitivity only and is never binding
control_statistic.random_projection_same_dim_same_norm: one fitted probe on a random tensor of the same shape and norm as F

criteria.strongest_control: max of the four frozen control statistics
criteria.checkpoint_aggregation: all four 20.4c_r2 final checkpoints evaluated independently; the binding verdict uses the STRICTEST (minimum margin); any disagreement across checkpoints implies inconclusive
criteria.forced_write_primacy: the binding verdict is computed under forced write, not under the actual sparse write. The actual-timing reading is reported as a separate named verdict and must never be promoted to the structural verdict, and the structural verdict must never be excused by the timing reading
criteria.question_axis_rule: per-question separability is assessed on the 22 distinct query texts; per-feedback-event separability on the 22 correction surfaces; the 11 distinct bit patterns are the semantic upper bound of independent content, so a PASS on texts with FAIL on bits is reported as text-level-only separability and does not satisfy the question axis

decision_rule.expressive_capacity_present: forced-write key_effective_rank >= 3 AND pairwise_separable_fraction >= 0.95 AND key_norm_median >= 1e-3 AND condition_number <= 100 AND query_alignment >= 0.5 AND value_effective_rank >= 3 AND capacity >= 22 AND closed_form_accuracy >= 0.6 AND margin >= 0.2 AND effective_dof >= 3 AND all four checkpoints agree; produces an ARCHITECTURE-REQUIREMENT INPUT only, not training admission, not pricing, not a capability claim
decision_rule.key_space_collapsed_structurally: under forced write, key_effective_rank < 3 OR pairwise_separable_fraction < 0.95 OR key_norm_median < 1e-3 OR condition_number > 100; this is a function-class verdict, independent of write timing and of training dose; range-limited to the current graph and the current checkpoint lineage
decision_rule.key_space_collapsed_under_actual_timing: under forced write the key gates pass, but under the actual sparse write they fail; this attributes the collapse to write timing, which is an engineering change, not an architecture change, and does not license training
decision_rule.query_key_misaligned: key gates pass but query_alignment < 0.5 or query_effective_rank < 3; the smallest sufficient fix is weight tying or a shared projection between write key and read query, not a new subject
decision_rule.value_space_collapsed: value_effective_rank < 3; the key space separates but the written values do not
decision_rule.capacity_below_event_count: capacity < 22; exponential forgetting bounds the matrix below the event count regardless of key quality
decision_rule.inconclusive: effective_dof < 3 OR checkpoint disagreement OR fewer than 22 assessable surfaces OR any gate exactly on its boundary; report every raw value and interval; no threshold change, no dose change, no automatic training transition
decision_rule.engineering_stop: any checkpoint sha mismatch / graph identity drift / criteria_sha256 mismatch / feature card not frozen before reading / confirm touched / runner dual hash mismatch / any parameter or optimizer mutation

budget.note: no training, no optimizer step; the only compute is forward replay of 4 checkpoints x 16 worlds x 3 write conditions plus the random-init control

expected_products: per-surface readings: 22 surfaces x 4 checkpoints x 3 write conditions
dual-statistic sensitivity: max-control binding, mean-control legacy reported only
forced-write vs actual-write verdict pair, reported separately and never merged
